Dependencies served locally by the study-material editor; no runtime CDN requests.

- Turndown 7.2.0: https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown (MIT).
  Source: https://unpkg.com/turndown@7.2.0/dist/turndown.js
- turndown-plugin-gfm 1.0.2: https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown-plugin-gfm (MIT).
  Source: https://unpkg.com/turndown-plugin-gfm@1.0.2/dist/turndown-plugin-gfm.js

The adjacent LICENSE files retain the upstream copyright notices.
Turndown converts edited document sections back to the existing Markdown storage.
Unedited sections keep their original Markdown without reserialization. GFM preserves tables.
